index.tagline: An EPUB reader for Apple Watch. Bring your own books; no account needed.
index.watch_label: Illustration: a book page displayed on a watch screen
index.watch_text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife. However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood…
index.what_lede: A full reading app, designed for the smallest screen you own.
index.f1_text: Import .epub books on your iPhone (Files, share sheet or the import button); they are sent to your watch, where you read them, offline.
index.f2_text: Adjustable typography (typeface, size, spacing, themes) from the watch or the iPhone.
index.f3_text: Offline word lookup on the watch with free, Wiktionary-based dictionaries you choose to download (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese and Chinese).
index.f4_text: Optional: sync reading progress using the KOReader Sync protocol, so you can continue in apps that speak the same protocol, such as KOReader and Readest. Sync is off unless you connect a server you choose; the app does not provide one.
index.f5_text: VoiceOver, larger text sizes and Dark Mode are supported.
index.f6_text: No DRM-protected books. No accounts with the developer, no ads, no analytics.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.updated: Last updated: 29 October 2026. Applies to the Folito apps for iPhone and Apple Watch.
privacy.summary: In short: Folito works without any account. It has no analytics, no advertising and no tracking, and the developer runs no server and receives no data. The app only contacts a sync server if you choose to set one up, and the dictionary download site named below when you download a dictionary.
privacy.local_1: Your books (EPUB files you import) are processed and stored in the app's storage on your iPhone and sent to your Apple Watch over Apple's WatchConnectivity, directly between your paired devices. They are never uploaded by the app.
privacy.local_2: Your reading positions, typography settings, a random device identifier (see below) and, if sync is on, progress waiting to be synced are stored in the app's settings on the device. Your typography settings are also sent to your paired watch.
privacy.local_3: Dictionaries you download are stored on your iPhone and your Apple Watch. Words are looked up on the watch itself, so what you look up never leaves the device. You can delete dictionaries in the iPhone app (Settings › Dictionaries).
privacy.local_4: Your sync login, only if you turn sync on (server address, username, password), is stored in the Keychain on your iPhone and, because the watch syncs on its own, also sent to your paired watch over WatchConnectivity and stored in the watch's own Keychain. It is never sent to the developer, and over the internet it goes only to the sync server you entered (see the next section).
privacy.local_readest: Your Readest session, only if you choose Readest for sync: your Readest email and a session token (never your Readest password) are stored in the Keychain on your iPhone and sent to your paired watch, which stores them in its own Keychain.
privacy.local_5: The app does not use iCloud. Deleting the app removes this data from that device.
privacy.sync_title: Reading-progress sync (optional, your KOReader Sync server)
privacy.sync_intro: Sync is off unless you turn it on. You do not need any account to import and read books. If you enter a KOReader Sync server, username and password and turn sync on, the app sends requests only to that server. (The server field suggests https://sync.koreader.rocks, the public KOReader server; nothing is sent to it until you save a username and password, and you can change it to your own server.) The app does not create accounts; you use an account you already have on that server. Requests can include:
privacy.sync_1: your username and an MD5 hash of your password (this is how the KOReader Sync protocol authenticates; your password itself is not sent to the server);
privacy.sync_2: a book identifier, which is a hash computed from the content of the EPUB file (not the file, its title or its text);
privacy.sync_3: your reading position in that book (a position reference and a percentage);
privacy.sync_4: the device name "Folito" and a random identifier generated by the app on first launch (it is not derived from your device's hardware and is not an advertising identifier).
privacy.sync_outro: The app does not send a timestamp; the server records its own. As with any internet request, the server sees your IP address. That server is run by whoever operates it (you, or a service you chose), not by the developer; its own privacy policy and retention rules apply, and the app cannot delete data stored there (ask the server operator). If you use http:// (allowed only for local-network addresses; iOS asks for local network permission the first time) the traffic is not encrypted. If you do not turn sync on, no sync requests are made.
privacy.readest_title: Reading-progress sync with Readest (optional, your Readest account)
privacy.readest_intro: Instead of a KOReader Sync server you can choose Readest in Settings › Progress Sync and sign in with a Readest account you already have; only one sync service is active at a time. Readest is a third-party service, not run by the developer, and Folito is not affiliated with it. When you sign in, your email and password are sent once over HTTPS to Readest's sign-in service (operated for Readest by Supabase); Folito does not store your password, only the session it receives. While sync is on, the app sends to Readest (web.readest.com):
privacy.readest_1: the session token that identifies your Readest account (renewed about once an hour by the watch);
privacy.readest_2: two book identifiers: a hash computed from the content of the EPUB file and a hash of the book's title, authors and identifier (not the file, its title or its text in readable form);
privacy.readest_3: your reading position in that book (a position reference, the paragraph number and count) and when you reached it.
privacy.readest_outro: No device identifier is sent to Readest. Readest stores your reading position in your Readest account, where the Readest apps and the Readest plugin for KOReader read it; Readest's privacy policy and terms apply, and data stored there is managed in Readest (the app cannot delete it). Sign Out in Settings › Progress Sync removes the session from your iPhone and Apple Watch and asks Readest to end it. If you do not choose Readest, nothing is sent to Readest.
privacy.dict_text: Looking up a word sends nothing anywhere: the dictionaries are on your watch. Only when you tap Download or Update in Settings › Dictionaries does the iPhone download a dictionary file over HTTPS from www.reader-dict.com (reader.dict, which compiles the files from Wiktionary). The request contains only the file's address, which shows the language you chose, and a User-Agent naming the app; the site sees your IP address and handles it under its own policy. While that screen is open, the app also asks the site (same information, no file transferred) whether an installed dictionary has changed. The iPhone then converts the file and sends it to your watch over the Apple Watch connection. No word, book title, text or reading position is ever sent.
privacy.not_1: No analytics, crash-reporting, advertising or other third-party SDKs, and no tracking across apps or websites.
privacy.not_2: No accounts with the developer; the developer receives no data from the app.
privacy.not_3: No sale or sharing of data.
privacy.children_text: The app is not directed at children and the developer collects no personal information from anyone.
privacy.rights_text: Sync is optional. To stop syncing, open Settings › Progress Sync on the iPhone and tap Turn Off Sync and Remove Login: the login is removed from your iPhone and your Apple Watch, and progress waiting to sync is discarded (your books and reading positions are kept). You can also remove the login on the watch alone (Settings › Remove Credentials), delete dictionaries, or delete the app at any time. For data held by a sync server or the dictionary download site, contact that service. For questions about this policy, write to xlahuerta@protonmail.com.
privacy.rights_readest: If you use Readest, tap Sign Out in Settings › Progress Sync to remove the session from both devices; your Readest account and the progress stored in it are managed in Readest.
privacy.changes_text: If the app's behaviour changes, this page will be updated and the date above changed.
support.title: Support
support.contact: Questions, bug reports or feature requests: xlahuerta@protonmail.com. Please include your iOS and watchOS versions and, if the problem is syncing, which server software you use. Never send your password.
support.start_1: Install Folito on your iPhone; the watch app installs through the Watch app on the iPhone (or automatically). Open the iPhone app once so the watch can be set up.
support.start_2: Import an .epub you own or a free public-domain one: tap Import EPUB (+) in the Library, or open the file from the Files app or the share sheet and choose Folito. The book is sent to your watch.
support.start_3: Open Folito on the watch and choose the book. Your place is saved on the watch, and reading works offline.
support.sync_title: Optional: sync your place with other readers
support.sync_1: Sync is off by default and only needed to continue the same book in KOReader or another app that speaks the KOReader Sync protocol. On the iPhone open Settings › Progress Sync, enter the server URL and the username and password of an account you already have on that server (create it on the server itself, for example in KOReader under Tools › Progress sync › Register; Folito does not create accounts), tap Save and Turn On Sync, then Test Connection. The login is sent to your watch so it can sync on its own.
support.sync_2: To stop syncing, tap Turn Off Sync and Remove Login: the login is removed from the iPhone and the watch; your books and reading positions are kept.
support.a1: No. Importing and reading need no account of any kind. Sync is optional and uses a server you choose; the developer runs no server.
support.a2: Any KOReader Sync (kosync) compatible server, including the public KOReader server and self-hosted ones. The app does not provide a server.
support.q3: Progress does not match in KOReader or Readest.
support.a3: It must be the same, unmodified EPUB file on every device. In Readest set the document matching method to File Content; in KOReader use Binary.
support.q4: My http:// server does not connect.
support.a4: iOS blocks plain http to internet hosts. Use https, or a local-network address (iOS asks for local network permission the first time).
support.q5: Word lookup says there is no dictionary or no definition.
support.a5: Download a dictionary for the book's language in the iPhone app (Settings › Dictionaries). It is sent to the watch and then works offline. If a word is missing, Folito tries simple base forms and your other installed dictionaries. Definitions are in the dictionary's own language (Spanish words are explained in Spanish).
support.a6: The iPhone and watch apps support VoiceOver and larger text sizes (Dynamic Type), follow Dark Mode, Increase Contrast and Bold Text, and use no custom animations. On the watch, reading themes meet WCAG contrast ratios and Typography › Match System Text Size makes the book text follow the watch's text size.
support.q7: Does the app support DRM-protected books?
